info.title: BetterMQ API
info.description: HTTP message broker — publish, queues, enqueue, flow control, cron, and DLQ. Authenticate with a panel-generated `sk_local_…` Bearer token.

tags.name: Queues
tags.description: Named destinations — webhook, retries, and parallelism

tags.name: Enqueue
tags.description: Jobs on a queue. Omit key for standard; set key for FIFO per entity

tags.description: Local panel auth / API token setup (no bearer required)

tags.name: Infra
tags.description: Self-host config, storage, and HA cluster management

PublishBody.description: Publish to a URL (url+secret) or fan-out to a group (group_id). Exactly one destination mode.

url.description: Direct destination URL (mutually exclusive with group_id)

flow_id.description: Pre-created flow profile (direct publish only). Prefer inline flowControl.

flowControl.description: Alias for flow — ensure/reuse profile by key on publish

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds (applies to url and group_id)

max_retries.description: Retry attempts after the first failure. 0 = no retries (single delivery attempt).

headers.description: Outbound headers as an object map, or curl-style array of [name, value] / "Name: value" strings

body_encoding.description: Optional encoding hint for body (e.g. base64)

retry_backoff.description: Backoff between retries (camelCase: kind, initialMs, maxMs, multiplier)

EnqueueBody.description: Enqueue a job. Omit `key` for standard delivery (queue parallelism). Set `key` for FIFO per entity. Retries default from the queue.

key.description: Optional FIFO lane. Empty/omit = standard. Same key is ordered; different keys run in parallel.

max_retries.description: Retry attempts after the first failure. 0 = no retries (single delivery attempt).

headers.description: Outbound headers as an object map, or curl-style array of [name, value] / "Name: value" strings

body_encoding.description: Optional encoding hint for body (e.g. base64)

retry_backoff.description: Backoff between retries (camelCase: kind, initialMs, maxMs, multiplier)

max_retries.description: Retry attempts after the first failure. 0 = no retries (single delivery attempt).

RetryBackoff.description: Backoff between delivery attempts. JSON keys are camelCase (kind, initialMs, maxMs, multiplier) matching the broker wire format.

reason.description: Why the message was moved to the DLQ (HTTP status, transport error, retries exhausted, …)

CreateQueueBody.description: Named destination. Retries and parallelism apply to new enqueues. Changing the URL does not affect in-flight jobs.

parallelism.description: Max in-flight for jobs without a key. 1 = serial queue. Omit or 0 = unconstrained (standard).

max_retries.description: Retry attempts after the first failure. 0 = no retries (single delivery attempt).

retry_backoff.description: Backoff between retries (camelCase: kind, initialMs, maxMs, multiplier)

parallelism.description: Max in-flight for jobs without a key. Omitted = unconstrained.

paused.description: When true, fan-out publish skips all members of this group

flow_key.description: Set to null to clear the member flow_key

paused.description: When true, this member is skipped during group fan-out

FlowControlBody.description: Inline flow control on publish. Reuses an existing profile when key + limits match; otherwise creates or updates. Also accepted as `flow`. Queue jobs do not use this — set a message `key` for FIFO or queue `parallelism` for standard.

key.description: Flow-control key. Defaults to the message routing key when omitted.

parallelism.description: Max concurrent in-flight deliveries for this key

rate.description: Max deliveries started per period. 0 = no rate limit.

period_secs.description: Rate window in seconds. Alias: period.

cron.description: 5- or 6-field cron. UTC by default. Prefix with CRON_TZ=<IANA> for a local timezone, e.g. CRON_TZ=America/New_York */5 * * * *.

key.description: When targeting a queue: FIFO lane. Omit for standard.

body_encoding.description: Optional encoding hint for body (e.g. base64)

max_retries.description: Retry attempts after the first failure. 0 = no retries (single delivery attempt).

retry_backoff.description: Backoff between retries (camelCase: kind, initialMs, maxMs, multiplier)

headers.description: Outbound headers as an object map, or curl-style array of [name, value] / "Name: value" strings

HttpDeliveryInput.description: Optional nested curl-style outbound overrides on publish/enqueue/cron

UpsertFlowControlBody.description: Body for PUT /v1/flow/{key}. Path supplies the key; do not send key here.

setup_open.description: First-boot password can be set during the setup window

setup_closes_in_secs.description: Seconds left on the first-boot window

post.summary: Publish to a URL or fan-out group
post.description: Provide either url+secret (1:1) or group_id (fan-out). Shared options: delay, retries, idempotency, priority, outbound HTTP fields.

get.description: Axum matches `{*destination}` — multi-segment URL-encoded paths are supported. Deprecated: query `secret` leaks via logs/Referer. Prefer POST /v1/publish. Query secrets require BETTERMQ_ALLOW_QUERY_SECRET=1.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: URL-encoded destination URL (may contain slashes); must start with http:// or https://

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: HMAC secret (deprecated; requires BETTERMQ_ALLOW_QUERY_SECRET=1)

400.description: Missing/disabled query secret or invalid destination

delete.summary: Purge one DLQ message, or every message on the topic if partition and offset are omitted

parameters.name: dlq_topic
parameters.description: Full DLQ topic (must end with .__dlq)

parameters.name: partition
parameters.description: Required with offset to delete one message. Omit both to delete every message on dlq_topic.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Required with partition to delete one message. Omit both to delete every message on dlq_topic.

200.description: Deleted every message on the DLQ topic
